description: Source code for the DailyWorkSummary document class in ERPNext, handling email summaries and replies.

classes.name: DailyWorkSummary
classes.description: Represents a daily work summary document with methods to send emails and generate message details.

methods.name: send_mails
methods.description: Sends emails with the daily work summary to specified users.

methods.name: send_summary
methods.description: Sends a summary of all replies, typically at midnight.

methods.name: get_message_details
methods.description: Generates message details including replies and users who did not reply.
